review_candidates.title: Expert Performance Manager & Stuurinformatie
review_candidates.description: Wil jij jouw talent inzetten voor het vertalen van proces-, risico- en control informatie naar betrouwbare managementinformatie? Als Expert Performance Management & Stuurinformatie bij Coöperatie VGZ krijg je de ruimte om dit voor de IT-organisatie te leveren. Zo kun jij groeien én een bijdrage leveren aan een gezonder Nederland. Voor iedereen. Benieuwd wat er allemaal komt kijken bij deze functie? Je leest het in deze vacature. Hoe jij het verschil maakt Als Expert Performance Management & Stuurinformatie beheer je de KPI- en KRI-rapportage van de IT-divisie van VGZ. Hierin bewaak je de kwaliteit van de onderliggende data en verzorgt de periodieke stuurinformatie over procesperformance en procesbeheersing. Je maakt in deze functie zichtbaar hoe de processen presteren, waar zij afwijken en waar bijsturing nodig is. De stuurinformatie gaat niet alleen over prestaties, maar ook over beheersing. Binnen de functie ben je primair verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van proces-, risico- en control-informatie naar betrouwbare managementinformatie waarop IT kan sturen. Je levert betrouwbare stuurinformatie voor management en processturing en zorgt voor de borging hiervan. In deze functie verwerk je de uitkomsten van control testing en de In Control Meting, de status van de beheersmaatregelen en de voortgang op bevindingen en maatregelen in hetzelfde beeld. Met als reden om performance en beheersing in samenhang zichtbaar te maken. Je bent hierin niet verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke onderbouwing. Dit ligt bij Corporate Interne Beheersing, maar ook bij de Procesmanagers IT en de Procesanalisten IT. De rapportages vinden plaats vanuit het risk en control framework en daarmee is de Expert IT Control Framework de belangrijkste stakeholder binnen VGZ. Sturing op processen vraagt om betrouwbare cijfers. Binnen de nieuwe afdeling IT Procesmanagement & Control is de Expert Performance Management & Stuurinformatie verantwoordelijk voor het inzichtelijk te maken van de prestaties van de processen binnen de IT-divisie. Ook heb je ervaring met het vertalen van data naar heldere inzichten voor operationele, tactische en bestuurlijke sturing. review_candidates.title: Director of Engineering, Technical Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients. About Compass International Holdings Compass International Holdings is the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in New York City in 2012 by Robert Reffkin and Ori Allon, and publicly traded on the NYSE, Compass was built on a simple premise: real estate agents are the heart of the transaction, and great technology makes them dramatically more effective. Following the combination with Anywhere Real Estate, Compass International Holdings operates a portfolio of the most recognized brands in the industry — including Compass, Coldwell Banker, Sotheby's International Realty, Corcoran, Century 21, and ERA — supporting a combined network of over 300K agents across approximately 120 countries and territories. What makes Compass International Holdings unusual in this industry is that we build our own software. Our end-to-end Home Platform, the Compass One client dashboard, and our AI assistant are developed in-house by engineering teams across New York, Seattle, Boston, and Miami. Technology is not a support function here; it is the product that differentiates the company. That is what makes infrastructure a first-class concern — and it is the premise of this role. Just as Compass makes agents more effective, Technical Infrastructure exists to make our Product and Engineering teams more effective. About the Role As Director of Engineering for Technical Infrastructure, you will own the platform that every engineer at Compass builds on. Tech Infra's mission is to empower our engineers to build, test, and ship high-quality software with maximum speed and confidence by providing a reliable, cost-effective "Golden Path" of centralized tools that eliminates operational complexity so product teams can focus on innovation. You will be accountable for that mission across compute, networking, databases, streaming, build and release systems, test infrastructure, observability, developer tooling, and the AI-enabled software development lifecycle. You will support a footprint that today spans more than 1,400 services, hundreds of managed datastores, and thousands of engineers' daily workflows. This is a manager-of-managers role in a functional area with an expectation to shape the infrastructure architecture and technology strategy for years to come. You will own a domain where the business problem is not always defined for you and the technology strategy could be genuinely open — where part of the job is determining what the right problem is before committing the organization to solving it. You will set the high-level vision and long-term direction, make the case for resourcing initiatives that span multiple years, and take on the endemic problems that have resisted easier fixes. You will be trusted with goals that matter at the company level, and judged on outcomes rather than activity. You will establish and evolve scalable team structures, recognizing when to create a team, when to hire a specialized role, and when teams should combine for a better outcome. You will demonstrate frugality by prioritizing the initiatives that achieve the greatest impact for the least resource, and by driving down the places where the organization applies the same engineering effort year after year. You will retain a strategic focus while staying close enough to the technology to ask the hard questions — where do we bottleneck the business, and should this system continue to exist at all. You will build closed-loop mechanisms that tell you quickly when an initiative is at risk, and act decisively. Above all, this is a leadership role. You will grow Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders through coaching, strategic project assignment, and genuine delegation of ownership. You will partner with Principal Engineers on the decisions that outlive any single roadmap, give credit visibly, own results in both directions, and build an organization that is better for your presence but does not depend on it. Responsibilities Own the Infrastructure Vision: Set the long-term technical direction for the Golden Path across cloud platform, build and release, data infrastructure, developer experience, and the AI-enabled software development lifecycle. Make the case for multi-year investment and decide what we improve, invent, deprecate, or simplify. Lead and Develop Leaders: Manage, coach, and grow a team of Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, and may directly manage one or two high-impact teams in a critical technology area. Build succession depth, develop and promote top performers, and handle complex people situations with judgment. Design the Organization: Structure teams to encapsulate technology areas cleanly so that customer, business, and technology needs are met. Recognize when to create a team, when to hire specialized roles, and when teams should combine for a better outcome. Drive Reliability and Deployment Safety: Reduce the blast radius and duration of production failures for every customer. Hold the organization to incident, time-to-resolution, and availability targets, and establish mechanisms that make regressions visible before they reach production. Own Cost Discipline at Scale: Shape and execute infrastructure cost-optimization strategy across the organization — setting reduction targets, establishing tracking metrics, forecasting accurately, and evaluating the cost-benefit of new projects and technologies against business objectives. Accelerate Developer Productivity: Treat internal engineers as customers. Drive build speed and reliability, test infrastructure quality, AI-assisted development adoption, and tooling maturity — and attack recurring operational toil wherever the organization spends the same engineering effort year after year. Communicate Strategically: Drive high-level written and verbal communication across senior leadership — tenets, architectural plans, planning documents, and business reviews — and input into company-level technical OKR planning. Requirements Strong Technical Background: 12+ years of software engineering experience with deep infrastructure or platform depth — cloud architecture, distributed systems, build and release engineering, managed data platforms, or large-scale operations. Manager of Managers: 8+ years of engineering management experience including proven success hiring, developing, and promoting Engineering Managers, and leading senior and staff-level ICs and geographically distributed teams.
